purpose.primary: Test the rating, calibration, assignment, disagreement, adjudication, and audit workflow on a small public development set before attempting the 400-critique Hard Set.
secondary: Estimate actual rating and adjudication time.
Measure initial and post-discussion expert agreement.
Identify rubric ambiguities and operational failure modes.
Produce empirical evidence for external-funding applications.
not_a_claim: Pilot 01 is not a hidden test set.
Pilot 01 does not establish that the public-synthetic source is representative of philosophical argument quality.
Pilot 01 does not complete or validate the planned 400-critique Hard Set.

selection_basis: Exactly four sibling critiques per position from the frozen public release.
No use of protected LMCA or newly hidden material.
Operational and reliability coverage rather than asserted difficulty optimization.

eligible_profiles: early-career researcher in a directly relevant adjacent field
researcher with equivalent demonstrated argument-evaluation expertise
selection_requirements: Relevant research or advanced training is verified.
Required consent and conflict disclosure are complete.
The frozen calibration is passed after human review.
The applicant can complete an assigned tranche during the four-week pilot window.
The applicant agrees not to use external AI assistance while rating.

nominal_assignment_range_per_core_rater.explanation: The exact number depends on whether four to eight qualified core raters are activated; every critique still receives two independent ratings.

tasks: Review the protocol and Rubric v2.
Comment on disagreement and adjudication triggers.
Identify methodological errors or missing safeguards.
Recommend qualified early-career raters and alternates.
Where applicable, advise on access to the canonical LMCA data and license terms.
bounded_request.optional_additional_task: Review no more than ten difficult disagreement cases unless a separate agreement is made.

delivery.start_rule: 00:00 UTC on the earliest Monday at least 72 hours after Ellen Sun signs the complete Pilot 01 readiness record
readiness_gate: The 12-position and 48-critique manifest is verified against synthetic-1000-v1.
Rubric v2, rating form, calibration, disagreement triggers, and adjudication protocol are frozen.
At least four qualified early-career core raters and at least one senior methodological adviser are confirmed.
Blind assignments cover every critique twice and prevent same-rater duplicate coverage.
Payment administration and applicable legal, tax, sanctions, and jurisdiction checks are complete for activated paid contributors.
Ellen Sun signs the readiness record.
completion_gate: All 96 required blind initial ratings are accepted or validly replaced.
All triggered disagreement cases are resolved or documented as unresolved.
The pilot result report and deidentified audit record are frozen.
At least one confirmed senior methodological adviser reviews the pilot summary.

unit_rules.core: One accepted blind initial rating or operator-assigned substantive re-rating earns one unit.
unit_rules.adjudication: One accepted required adjudication closure or final pilot sign-off earns one unit.
unit_rules.distribution: Each released pool is distributed pro rata by accepted eligible units using largest-remainder cent rounding.
unit_rules.unused_adjudication_balance: Remain unspent; do not transfer silently to the core pool.

required_outputs: Completion, withdrawal, replacement, and missing-data counts.
Median and 90th-percentile rating time for accepted initial ratings.
Initial human-human agreement using the LMCA custom weighted loss and within-position ordering agreement.
Number and proportion of ratings and positions triggering adjudication.
Adjudication time and categorized causes of disagreement.
Observed source, length, style, and domain confound diagnostics.
measurement.interpretation: The project owner and senior methodological adviser review the complete results before any expansion decision.

submission_gate: At least one senior methodological feedback record is available and permission to quote or attribute it is recorded.
Requested scope and budget are recalculated from observed pilot workload rather than the LMCA 5–15 minute estimate alone.
